# One fix round, so two candidates, does not satisfy the review. The item pauses and asks the owner to rule on the open findings.
# After the answer, the settle step applies the ruling once and the run ends. The pull request is not marked ready.
replace config/projects/shop.star '"fix_rounds": 5' '"fix_rounds": 1'
exec beehest run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &

# The run has opened the store once the first agent call is in the record.
waitfile calls.log
waitstatus 'paused: The review loop used all of its rounds'

exec beehest status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\tpaused: The review loop used all of its rounds'
! grep '^settle ' calls.log

exec beehest answer 7 keep the current API
wait
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehest status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone'

# The fixes after candidate 1 are fix round 1, and the fixes inside candidate 1 are round 1 too. Each candidate has three scoped fixes:
# the hit of the implementer is due at once, so candidate 1 has three too.
grep -count=6 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 2 ' calls.log
grep -count=8 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^settle +[ab] keep the current API$' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
